artworks.title: The Virgin Appearing to a Dying Priest
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description:
The image shows a medieval illustration featuring several figures. In the foreground, a person is lying in a bed, covered with a white blanket. This person is shown from the waist up and appears to be looking towards a group of people standing by the bedside. Their facial features are detailed with wide eyes and hair falling to the side, wearing a white robe with a halo.

Next to the bed, four figures are standing, all dressed in flowing robes. One figure has a covered head, resembling a nun's habit, and another appears to be wearing a crown. These figures have serene faces, with hands raised as if in conversation or blessing. Their clothing is detailed and appears typical of the attire from that time. In the background, there is a simple hilly landscape visible through an open window or awning.

Below the illustration, medieval text is elegantly written in black ink, with an ornate red letter 'M' starting the passage. The parchment has a textured appearance, typical of medieval manuscripts.

artworks.title: The Poacher
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a prominent, twisted tree reaching over a body of water. The sky fills the upper portion of the scene, with faint outlines of clouds and birds visible. The detailed etchings show textures of the tree, foliage, and water with fine brushstrokes. The color scheme is monochromatic in black, gray, and white. Near the foreground, two figures sit on the tree, one playing a flute. The branches extend towards the water, showing reflections of the trees. Vegetation grows densely in the distance, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Elegant Young Woman en Promenade
artworks.medium: brush and ink with watercolor and blue crayon
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the back, walking away from the viewer. She is holding an umbrella in her right hand and wearing a black hat, a fur-like textured coat in dark colors, a vivid purple garment underneath, black shoes, and blonde hair. The background shows a light surface transitioning from cobblestones to pavement, with a streetlamp or pole on the right and another figure in dark clothing and a top hat on the left.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The drawing depicts a group of figures gathered around a newborn baby in a traditional nativity arrangement. The focus is on the central figure of the baby, with various figures positioned around, bending forward as if to observe and reverence. In the upper part of the drawing, there is a cherub or angel figure. The drawing uses light pencil or ink on a plain background, with shading and line work to create depth and texture. The overall style suggests a classical religious theme, rendered in a sketch format to convey a sense of immediacy and warmth.

artworks.title: The Sack of the Temple at Jerusalem
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 45.2 x 70.2 cm (17 13/16 x 27 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The image shows figures engaged in combat, including warriors with swords and shields in a landscape with architectural ruins. Details include columns and statues. The figures are in dynamic poses, emphasizing the intensity of the scene. Two smaller panels below show additional scenes. Intricate detailing and shading contribute to the drawing's atmosphere.

artworks.title: Francesco Algarotti
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a profile portrait of a man with curly hair, shown from the shoulders up. He is facing left, with his head and neck visible. His features are depicted in a classical style, resembling those from ancient art, including a noticeable nose and defined lips. The man has a youthful appearance and is not wearing any visible clothing. The portrait is within an elaborate oval frame within a larger, ornate design with intricate details and patterns. Below the portrait is a rectangular relief with classical figures engaged in various activities, depicted in a detailed style. The background has a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Johann Melchior Dinglinger
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt after Antoine Pesne
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man. He is turned slightly to his left, looking sideways. He has a round face, prominent cheeks, and a slightly upturned mouth. His short, curly hair is styled with a large, decorative hat with a feather. He is wearing a fur-collared coat with rich details, suggesting formality. The background is a plain, oval-shaped vignette, highlighting the subject, with no additional details present. The man is not wearing any visible jewelry nor holding any objects.

artworks.title: Hirsch Michel
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is slightly turned to his right but looking ahead. The man has an aged face with deep wrinkles, a bushy beard, and a moustache. His hair is mostly covered by a large, dark hat. He is wearing a heavy, textured garment with fur-lined sleeves and cuffs. His hands are in front of his abdomen, left hand crossing over the right. The background has a densely etched pattern.

artworks.title: Monseigneur Louis-Charles d'Orléans de Saint-Albin, Archbishop of Cambrai
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 51.4 x 37.6 cm (20 1/4 x 14 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a detailed chair. He has shoulder-length curly hair and a defined face. He is wearing an intricate robe with a cross pendant around his neck. One hand is on his chest, and the other rests on a book. The background has architectural elements with columns and drapery.

artworks.title: The Old Soldier
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual facing forward. The person's face, shoulders, and upper body are captured. The individual has a weathered face with a beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, and a calm expression. Their hair is thick and somewhat unkempt, and they wear a cap or hat with feathers. The person is dressed in a textured garment with small details on the shoulders and upper chest. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Persian
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 16.6 x 12.9 cm (6 9/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man. He is facing the viewer with one hand on a cane, while the other hand is not visible. The man has a full beard and mustache, dark eyes, and wears a turban with a feather. He is dressed in a textured coat and outer garment, and wears a thick chain around his neck. The background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for L'Illustration Nouvelle: The Burial of the Burin
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a steam locomotive with symbolic imagery and chaos surrounding it. The painting showcases a steam engine with "L'ILLUSTRATION NOUVELLE PARIS" and the year "1877" prominently displayed on its front. The locomotive is heading towards the foreground along a set of tracks. In the background, the landscape and sky are filled with various figures, celestial beings, clouds, and smoke, creating a scene of chaos. Figures appear to be in different states of movement, interacting with each other in the sky. There are shadows, demons, and other mythical entities shown in the scene. The left side of the canvas features the year "1876."

artworks.title: Le Château des hiboux (Castle of the Owls)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, roulette, stop-out, sulphur tint, and crayon stop-out in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description:
The image shows a composite design with two sections. On the left side, there is a circular nocturnal scene with water, a bird flying, a castle-like silhouette, glowing lights, a bright moon partially obscured by clouds, and a horizon line. The brushstroke technique is soft and fluid, and the color palette is composed of muted grays and dark blues. 

On the right side, there is a graphic design with ships, books, and banners with the text "EX LIBRIS" in dark, monochromatic tones. The design uses defined lines and intricate patterns. The juxtaposition of the two sections creates a balance between simplicity and complexity in the image.

artworks.title: Feuillets d'album (Donkey Sketch)
artworks.medium: etching on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image is a detailed, monochrome illustration depicting a rustic countryside scene. The composition includes various elements such as a donkey with a basket, birds, a stone building, two donkeys walking towards a river, a sailboat, a winding road with figures, a person with a camel near a river, small boats, trees, and hills. The drawing style consists of fine brushstrokes and detailed line work, resembling an etching.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for L'Illustration Nouvelle: The Burial of the Burin
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray and white gouache and white chalk heightening over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image contains swirling and angular lines creating an abstract composition. There is a bold, curved shape on the right side resembling a steam locomotive, with a smokestack. On the left, finer lines form clusters of small figures. In the background, there are sketches resembling birds in flight against a muted backdrop. The abstract design leaves room for interpretation, connecting elements with familiar objects such as a train, a group of people, and birds in a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Landing in England
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, roulette, and spirit ground on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a busy dock area, with people walking around, some carrying umbrellas. A large mast with a flag can be seen in the distance. The scene is portrayed using crosshatched etching marks, creating a monochrome color palette of grey and black. On the left side, there are smaller, less detailed vignettes.

artworks.title: Marine: Souvenir of Medway
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a sailboat sailing on a choppy sea, with a low horizon separating the water from the sky. The style is detailed and resembles an etching, using fine lines to show the movement of clouds and the rocky shoreline. The color scheme is black and white, creating contrast and a dramatic mood. Dark clouds fill the sky in the distance.

artworks.title: A Sketch: Street in Driving Rain
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on artificial vellum paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 3.9 x 16 cm (1 9/16 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection

artworks.title: Breton Port with an Approaching Storm
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image depicts a marina or port scene from an elevated perspective, showing activity on the water and figures on the shore. The horizon is suggested by distant ships and a lighthouse on the right. The artwork uses dynamic brushstrokes to convey movement, particularly in the waves and a sail. The color palette is soft, with beige, cream, and black tones, giving the image an aged look. People are gathered at the water's edge, with ships in the distance adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Un Débarquement en Angleterre (Landing in England)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, roulette, and spirit ground on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image showcases a busy promenade near a harbor. The scene is filled with people and structures, with ships' masts and flags visible in the background. Dark clouds cover the sky, birds fly above, and the overall color palette is grey and black. People are depicted walking on the wet promenade, some holding umbrellas, accompanied by a dog. The surface reflects light due to rain, conveyed through cross-hatching and linear strokes.

artworks.title: An Elaborate Altar of Colored Marble Ornamented with Sculptures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown, red, and ochre washes and gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural altar design. It includes a central section dominated by intricate architectural features such as tall columns and detailed carvings. The structure is adorned with classical figures, including reclining nudes and cherubic forms, which flank the top and sides. The drawing showcases a symmetrical design with sculpted niches housing statues of classical figures on either side. The base of the structure is embellished with colorful decorative elements and intricate details.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy: Ruins of a Circular Temple Seen through a Natural Arch
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and gouache over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of a cave looking out towards an architectural structure. The view includes the cave's rocks, foliage, the architectural columns and archways, and the sky with clouds peeking through an arch. The colors used are soft browns, greens, whites, blues, and reds. The cave rocks are rough and moss-covered, while the architectural elements are precise and detailed. The color palette combines earth tones with muted architectural colors.
